main_body: Round leafy canopy (about rows 0-31) on a short brown trunk, with a grass patch at the base
top_band: Lighter mid-to-light green clumps at the upper canopy (rows ~1-8), with darker green shading clumps below. The canopy reads as a volume, not a flat band.
evidence: The canopy is a lit rounded mass: light clumps sit on top and a dark underside lies at rows ~17-24 and ~28-31, where it overhangs the trunk. The trunk is a vertical face with a shadowed base. For an organic tree this reads as a volumetric 3/4 object, not a flat elevation or a plan. A crisp front-edge line does not apply to foliage.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 5 green steps and a dark teal-green outline tinted by the foliage, which is good. The clumps are large and blocky (about 4-6 px patches of one tone) and lack the small leaf-cluster dots and scalloped edges of the references. The trunk is a simple flat brown column with little grain. The silhouette is smooth and simplified, so the piece looks flatter and thinner than the Beodeul trees at the same scale.
